A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Ouroboros study, with readable and corresponding methods, equations, tables, and figures. All 13 pages of each were inspected. Both end with references; neither includes a separate appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original rendering evaluations in Tables 1–5, qualitative image and video results, and cycle-training ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical evaluations and ablations, with selected numerical results revised.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 retain the same single-step diffusion models, task-specific losses, cycle training, and training-free video inference procedure.

E1.justification: Both use Hypersim, InteriorVerse, and MatrixCity, plus MSCOCO and Flickr30k for cycle training. The rendering tasks and qualitative video scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout Tables 1–5 and Figure 1, including RGB↔X and the task-specific albedo, normal, irradiance, and material-estimation baselines.

E3.justification: The reported training sample counts, test sets, input modalities, metrics, and video-inference settings are unchanged. Neither PDF documents a protocol revision accompanying the changed scores.

E4.justification: The inference-step comparison, qualitative case studies, and ablations of cycle training, wild-data training, and e2e loss retain the same evidence and questions.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed lists, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Uncertainty-reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Eight numerical cells change. In Table 1, Hypersim PSNR/LPIPS changes from 20.17/0.11 to 18.67/0.20 for RGB↔X and from 20.71/0.19 to 18.98/0.23 for Ouroboros. In Table 4, Ouroboros's InteriorVerse roughness changes from 19.56/0.19 to 17.83/0.08, and metallicity from 21.96/0.18 to 13.85/0.12. Rankings in these columns remain unchanged. Other numerical results and qualitative examples are retained.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–9 are unchanged, including diffusion parameterization, task losses, cycle consistency, and video latent initialization. No proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and discussion retain the same claims about rendering quality, 50-fold inference acceleration, cycle consistency, and training-free video decomposition.

C2.justification: The interpretations of material estimation, lighting recovery, and generalization remain unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning unreliable intrinsic maps and insufficient training-data quality and quantity.

D1.justification: UNet finetuning details, BLIP/BLIP-2 captioning, dataset sample counts, video initialization weight, and the project-page access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 89 references and related-work discussion are retained, including the positioning relative to RGB↔X, E2E, DiffusionRenderer, and CycleGAN.

P1.justification: The marginal arXiv version/date stamp changes from v1, 20 August 2025, to v2, 7 October 2025. Manuscript wording, headings, and paragraph order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All nine figures and five tables retain their panels, captions, structure, and placement. The numerical substitutions in Tables 1 and 4 do not redesign the displays.

improvement.justification: The substantive revisions are unexplained score replacements in Tables 1 and 4. Rankings and claims remain stable, with no added validation or reproducibility information. The PDFs do not establish whether the replacements correct errors or improve evidential reliability, so their net effect on paper quality cannot be determined.
